description:
Job Responsibilities 
 Develop and maintain software features for FortiGate products. 

 Participate in developing firewall features, including session management, packet processing, hardware acceleration, IPsec, and QoS. 

 Develop and maintain Linux kernel components and device drivers for network processors and switch chips. 

 Improve system performance, reliability, and scalability. 

 Utilize AI-assisted coding tools to improve development productivity, code understanding, debugging, and testing. 

 Job Requirements 
 M.S. or B.S. in Computer Science, or a related field. 

 Must be authorized to work in the U.S. without sponsorship 

 Work onsite in Sunnyvale, CA 

 Programming knowledge and experience in C/C++. 

 Familiarity with Linux operating systems and command-line development environments. 

 Basic understanding of computer networking concepts, such as TCP/IP, routing, and switching. 

 Good problem-solving, analytical, and debugging skills. 

 Familiarity with AI coding assistants and willingness to use AI to assist with coding, debugging, testing, and code analysis. 

 Ability to understand, review, and validate AI-generated code. 

 Fortinet offers employees a variety of benefits, including medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k), 11 paid holidays, vacation time, and sick time as well as a comprehensive leave program. 
 Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labor market, job type, and job level. Earnings for this position are expected to be $91,200 - $152,000. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate's subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, experience, and geographic location.
 All roles are eligible to participate in the Fortinet equity program, bonus eligibility is reviewed at time of hire and annually at the Company’s discretion.
